why: Image 2 reads more like a real Amsterdam night: a blue-black sky, dark brick facades lit only by their windows, warm reflections breaking up on the canal, and a crisp coloured shadow of the sphere on a paving texture that holds up when cropped. Its hard-edged white spotlight disk looks theatrical and is the main CG giveaway, but Image 1 is worse overall, with a sepia fog that floods the facade and the quay in one even warm wash, a muddy, soft ground, and an unexplained dark band across the foreground.
